newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,161 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,161 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,161 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 75 wheat contracts, 434 corn, 618 soybean, 18 soymeal and 16 soyoil futures contracts traded, along with 13 corn call and and five soybean call options.
The overnight trend for corn was down two to 2-1/2 cents per bushel, soybeans down seven to 7-1/4 cents, wheat down one to 2-1/2 cents, soymeal down $2.40 a ton and soyoil down 0.30 cent a lb.
